executive_summary: Episode 8 continues the investigation into Erika Kirk, presenting evidence about her background at Tesseract School/Notre Dame Prep under Bishop Thomas J. O'Brien, who faced felony charges and a grand jury investigation for covering up priest abuse. The episode details Erika's timeline from 2015-2018, including her employment at Next Model Management, formation of multiple LLCs by her mother Lori, and her introduction to Charlie Kirk via Tyler Bowyer. A significant new claim alleges Erika had undisclosed connections to Kanye's inner circle during the Blexit controversy, potentially influencing Kanye's tweets that damaged Candace and Charlie's reputation. The episode concludes by drawing parallels between Erika and the Kouri Richins murder case.

claims.label: Erika attended Notre Dame Prep for high school
claims.claim: After Tesseract School filed for bankruptcy in 2001, the campus was purchased by the Diocese of Phoenix and turned into Notre Dame Prep, where Erika enrolled for high school.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain school enrollment records to verify Erika's attendance at Notre Dame Prep.
claims.transcript_snippet: they then turned it into Notre Dame Prep, where Erika then enrolls for high school

claims.label: Bishop O'Brien charged with felony hit-and-run
claims.claim: Bishop Thomas J. O'Brien became the first Catholic bishop in America to be charged with a felony for a 2003 hit-and-run that killed Jim Lee Reed.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain court records from the 2003 hit-and-run case to verify details.
claims.transcript_snippet: the very first Catholic bishop in America to ever be charged with a felony

claims.label: Bishop O'Brien investigated for covering up priest abuse
claims.claim: In 2002, Maricopa County prosecutors initiated a grand jury investigation into Bishop O'Brien for allegedly covering up sexual abuse allegations against priests he had staffed.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain grand jury investigation records from Maricopa County.
claims.transcript_snippet: prosecutors initiated a grand jury investigation into charges of sexual abuse by Catholic priests... He became a target of the investigation for allegedly covering up the allegations

claims.label: Erika's financial situation unclear 2015-2018
claims.claim: Between 2015-2018, Erika was 27-30 years old with no clear employment, yet lived in NYC and traveled internationally.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain employment records and financial documents to verify income sources.
claims.transcript_snippet: in 2015, Erika is 27 years old... It is entirely unclear what she is doing for work... how is she affording to live

claims.label: Lori Frantzve runs multiple LLCs with government connections
claims.claim: Lori Frantzve established G-Tech Industries LLC in 2015 and was 86% owner of Saxon Capital Group, both involved in EMP fear-mongering and government contracts.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain corporate filings and contract records for G-Tech Industries and Saxon Capital Group.
claims.transcript_snippet: her mother establishes G-Tech Industries LLC... Saxon Capital Group is actually Lori. Lori is an 86% owner of Saxon Capital Group

claims.label: Erika appeared in EMP documentary with CIA Director
claims.claim: Erika appeared in the documentary Black Starts by Patricia Patrick alongside CIA Director James Woolsey, which promoted EMP attack concerns connected to her mother's business.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain a copy of the documentary and verify Erika's role and connections.
claims.transcript_snippet: she then appears in this documentary that's called Black Starts by Patricia Patrick. The documentary also features the CIA director James Woolsey

claims.label: Erika claimed to launch Bible in 365 in 2016
claims.claim: Erika claims she started Bible in 365 in 2016 in her NYC apartment, but corporate filings do not support this.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain corporate filings for Bible in 365 to verify founding date.
claims.transcript_snippet: Later on in the future, she's going to claim that this is the year that she launched Bible in 365... That is objectively untrue according to corporate filings
claims.uncertainty_note: No corporate filing artifact shown in episode

claims.label: Erika got real estate license October 2018
claims.claim: On October 24, 2018, Erika became a licensed real estate agent in New York and was employed by Corcoran Real Estate Group.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain real estate licensing records from New York State.
claims.transcript_snippet: October 24th and Erika somehow becomes a licensed real estate agent in New York and is immediately employed by Corcoran Real Estate Group

claims.label: Erika had undisclosed connections to Kanye's circle
claims.claim: During the October 2018 Blexit controversy when Kanye tweeted negatively about Candace and Charlie, Erika was making claims to people that she knew people in Kanye's orbit and may have influenced the tweet.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain evidence from the New York woman who provided proof of Erika's claims about knowing Kanye's circle.
claims.transcript_snippet: Proof that at the very least Erika was making that claim... she knew the people that were around Kanye that she had family that was around Kanye and pushed for that tweet to go out
claims.uncertainty_note: Based on witness testimony, not documentary evidence shown

claims.label: Feed Me Incorporated formed as Erika started dating Charlie
claims.claim: Feed Me Incorporated was formed on December 31, 2018 (became Superfeed Technologies) with both Lori Frantzve and Tyler Bowyer on the board, around the time Erika began dating Charlie.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain corporate records for Feed Me Incorporated and Superfeed Technologies to verify board membership and timing.
claims.transcript_snippet: December 31st... Feed Me Incorporated is formed... will eventually become Superfeed Technologies... both Erika's mother and Tyler Bowyer are on the board

claims.label: Matt Walsh hypocritically defended Erika then condemned Kouri Richins
claims.claim: Matt Walsh defended Erika against criticism while simultaneously tweeting that Kouri Richins (convicted of killing husband) should be hanged, despite the case relying on circumstantial evidence similar to points raised about Erika.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Matt Walsh's public statements on both cases.
claims.transcript_snippet: Matt Walsh... very much been on the side of how dare you talk to a grieving widow... yesterday he tweeted this regarding a murder that took place in Utah... There's no good moral reason why she should not simply be taken outside... and hanged

claims.label: Kouri Richins case used as parallel to Erika situation
claims.claim: The host argues that grief behavior, financial motives, and circumstantial evidence in the Kouri Richins case parallel concerns about Erika's situation after Charlie's death.
claims.investigative_direction: Analyze similarities and differences between the two cases.
claims.transcript_snippet: Grieving widows do not lie about threats that their husbands were facing the night before their deaths
claims.uncertainty_note: Analogical argument, not direct claim about Erika

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet claimed Erika never sought spotlight
claims.claim: Andrew Kolvet stated on the Dave Rubin show that Erika never sought the limelight and was always supportive of Charlie.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Dave Rubin interview with Andrew Kolvet.
claims.transcript_snippet: Erika has always been tremendous and she never sought the limelight
